ela: [ ela(ḷa)ṇḍa + iya ] (ḷa)ṇḍiya (ti) CL=7 Finished with castor oil (plant).
elaeḷa: [ ila + ṇa.] (ti) CL=7 [Ila + a. Dhāna,ṭī. 281,591. Ilanti jigucchitabbabhāvena kampenti hadayacalanaṃ pāpuṇanthīti janāetthāti elo. Kheḷo. Nīti,dhā. 168,169. I+la. Eti gacchatīti ‌e‌lā. Sukhumelā. Moga,7.188. Elā(saṃ)] (thī) (1) Spittle. (2) Saliva. (3) Cardamom plant. Cardamom fruit. (dhāna.) (Na) (4) An offense. (5) Water. (Pu) (6) Ela gold pot. A gold pot is called Ela. (7) A deaf person.
elagalaelagaḷaeḷagalaeḷagaḷaeḷāgaḷa: [ elā (eḷā)+gala (gaḷa).] (pu) CL=7 [Elā + gala + a] (1) Salivate or water at the mouth. The saliva that drips (drools) from the mouth. (2) Dripping the saliva (drooling). A drop of spittle that drips from the mouth. (Ti) (3) Dripping the drops of saliva (drooling) (while speaking). (Words (sound)) with the drop of saliva (drooling) that drips out. (The words (sound) of a person who drips the drops of spittle (drooling) while speaking. (4) (Words (sound) with the dripping of drops of spittle (drooling) while speaking. (5) Words (sound) that come out of the offense. (incomplete words (sound), not clear words (sound), etc.,).
elagaḷavirahita: [ elagaḷa + virahita ] (ti) CL=7 (1) Free from dripping out the drops of saliva (drooling). Lack of leaking the saliva (drooling). (2) Free from dripping the drops of saliva (drooling). Without dripping of drops of saliva (drooling) (while speaking). (Words (sound) who is without dripping out the drops of saliva (drooling) while speaking).
elakeṭu: [ yādicchakanāma ] (pu,na) CL=7 A river tern bird (jā,ṭī,saca.). A blackbird (Jātaka). A shrikle bird. (jātaka,sya.)
elambuja: [ ela + ambuja ] (na) CL=7 Padummā lotus that grows in the water.
elamphuraka: [ yādicchakanāma ] (pu,na) CL=7 An orchid plant that is a creeper vine. See below.
elamphurakasañchanna: [ eḷamphuraka + sañchanna ] (ti) CL=7 Covered with the creeper vine of orchid (plant).
elamuga: See - Elamuka, elamukha, elamuga, elamūka, eḷamukha, eḷamūga.
elamukaelamukhaelamugaelamūkaeḷamukhaeḷa: [ ela (eḷa) + mukha.] (ti) CL=7 (1) With the dripping drops of saliva. One who is dripping drops of saliva (drooling) while speaking. (2) With an offensive mouth (words (sound)). One who speaks incomplete words (sound). (3) (A snake) who has a mouth with dripping saliva(drooling). (4) One who is deaf and mute. (5) One who is like a mute person due to offense. (who doesn"t develop the seven factors of bojjhaṅga). (6) An inferior person. (7) A stupid person.
elamūgakathā: [ elamūga + kathā ] (thī) CL=7 Words (sound) of a stupid person. See - Eḷa(la)-mūgakathā.
elapati: [ ela + pata + i ] (thī) CL=7 (1) Free from dripping saliva (drooling). Without dripping saliva (drooling). (2) Free from dripping of the drops of saliva (drooling). Without the dripping saliva (drooling).
elapātavirahita: [ elapāta + virahita ] (ti) CL=7 (1) Free from dripping saliva. (2) Free from dripping of the drips of saliva. Without dripping saliva. See - Elapati.
elasabbhāva: [ ela + sabbhāva ] (ti) CL=7 With an obvious offense. See - Elamuka... (1)(2).
elasaññita: [ ela + saññita ] (ti) CL=7 Should be designated water, and wind. See - Elambūja.
elayati: [ ila + ṇaya + ti ] (kā,kri) CL=7 It causes to agitate.
elā: [ ira + lā + u + ka.] (ḷā) luka (na) CL=7 [Iraṃ vāraṃ lāti tabbāhulyatoti eḷā-lukaṃ.... Thiyaṃ, u, sakatthe ko. Dhāna,ṭī. 597. Eḷālu (thī). Eḷāluka (na). Evāruka (saṃ)] Cucumber (fruit).
